Name: 240 Slots backpack
Author: SHASHFORGE
Description:
240 Slot Backpack
[heading]Description[/heading]
Expand your inventory to [b]240 slots[/b] with a clean and convenient scrollable backpack interface. Carry more crops, tools, fish, minerals, resources, and other items without constantly running back to your chests.
The mod keeps the normal hotbar while providing a large expanded inventory that you can easily navigate with scrolling. It is designed as a simple, lightweight quality-of-life upgrade for players who want more carrying capacity without complicated backpack progression systems.
Whether you're spending a full day in the mines, filling your farm with harvests, or going on a long fishing and foraging trip, [b]240 Slot Backpack[/b] gives you the extra space to keep exploring.
